properties.w: Senegal is a modern name. In 1530 the Jolof Empire held much of this region, with Kaabu (under Mali) to the south and the Denanke kingdom of Futa Toro on the Senegal River.

properties.n: Patagonian shellfish and marine mammal hunters

properties.w: Jurchen tribes, which the Ming counted as its frontier guards, and the Tungusic peoples of the Amur. The Ming ruled only Liaodong.
Unknown to Europeans until 1596 (some read a 1194 Norse saga as an earlier sighting); no state ruled it.
